info.title: ES_Microservice
info.description: Aggregated API documentation for all EventSphere microservices

post.summary: Make payment on an approved expense
Create an expense for an event

get.summary: Get payment status by payment ID

expense-manager_PaymentRequestDto.description: Request payload for making a payment on an approved expense

expense-manager_PaymentResponseDto.description: Response payload containing payment transaction details

expenseId.description: Expense ID this payment settles; null for invoice payments

invoiceId.description: Invoice ID this payment settles; null for expense payments

expense-manager_ExpenseRequestDto.description: Request payload for creating a new expense

amount.description: Amount of the expense, must be greater than 0

date.description: Date on which the expense was incurred (yyyy-MM-dd)

expense-manager_ExpenseResponseDto.description: Response payload containing the details of an expense

eventId.description: Unique identifier of the event this expense belongs to

date.description: Date on which the expense was incurred

approvedBy.description: UUID of the user who approved the expense; null if not yet approved

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the expense

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the expense record was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the expense record

expense-manager_BudgetRequestDto.description: Request payload for creating or updating a budget for an event

plannedAmount.description: The planned financial ceiling for the event; must be greater than 0

expense-manager_BudgetResponseDto.description: Response payload containing the financial details of an event's budget

budgetId.description: Unique identifier of the budget record

eventId.description: Unique identifier of the event this budget belongs to

plannedAmount.description: The planned financial ceiling set at budget creation

actualAmount.description: Total approved expenses accumulated so far; starts at 0

variance.description: Difference between planned and actual spend (plannedAmount - actualAmount); positive means under budget, negative means over budget

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the budget record was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the budget record
